title: Twisted Ruelle zeta at zero and Reidemeister-Turaev torsion for compact hyperbolic orbisurfaces

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard functional analysis, measure theory and the author-cited classical theorems
standard_prerequisites.use: Standard prior results stay cited; complete source-local proofs and definitions retained.

core_obligations: The author computes the geodesic Euler structure and twisted combinatorial torsion on a Seifert-type unit tangent bundle, and matches them with the nonunitary orbifold Selberg trace formula. Meromorphic continuation, elliptic contributions and zero-eigenvalue multiplicities determine the complete Ruelle zero behavior and its sign in both original fiber-action regimes.
